May 1869
Port of Arrival: Baltimore, Maryland
in the Baltimore, Maryland, U.S., Passenger Lists, 1820-1964

Wednesday afternoon Wilhelm Wels died in the farmhouse of his son Herman Wels in Nicollet TP. The Berset. Mr. Wels was in Morien, Prot). Brandenburg, German, was born on May 26, 1821, and came directly from there to Nicollet County in 1869, where he lived until his death. He was married three times. His third wife died about 13 years ago. The following children survive him: Mrs. Wm. Meyer, Mrs. Christ. Schmidt and Hermann Wels of Nicollet and Wm. Wels of Lewis Me. Besides these there were 38 grandchildren and 49 grandchildren on his bier. The funeral sand SamStagnach with day of the Luther. Church in Nicollet from. Past. Köhler officiated.
"Grandfather Wels", as he was called, was an
old pioneer respected by everyone
